method: Independent Decimal precision50 from fresh manually read source coefficients; old Fraction outputs only compared afterwards. Algebraic limits, no trajectories, regression or tests.
initial_normalization_assumptions: Mbar(0)=M0 and M0 != Me; printed rounding retained, no coefficient repair.
derivation: All Ki>0 implies f(infinity)=0; for60/70C the sole negative K3 has positive A3, so f(infinity)=+infinity.
For all six heating fits A2,K1,A3>0: theta*=A1+A2*K1*log2(t)+o(1), hence +infinity in the source numerical time convention.

unit_derivations.qualification: Equals counted brick area per bed volume only if Vt=VP on the same volume basis and A0 represents the counted interface. Printed40.34 is not independently reconstructed from loading inputs.

unit_derivations.derivation: epsilon=1-Ntj*Vt/Vvag is dimensionless on compatible volumes.
unit_derivations.qualification: A bed-loading calculation; matrix porosity is not supplied. Whether channels count as void depends on Vt definition, not established merely by the formula.

unit_derivations.derivation: With Ma kg/mol, R must be J/(mol K); Pa*m^3=J then P*Ma/(R*Tabs) has kg/m^3. Matching kg/kmol and J/(kmol K) also works.
unit_derivations.qualification: 8314.34 J/kg degC is kept as printed; kmol interpretation is inference, not a source correction. NIST TableXXXIII PDF50 confirms molar units and standard atmosphere101325Pa; no new runtime value adopted.

unit_derivations.derivation: 1kJ=1000J; ca,cv,cw in kJ/(kgK) cannot be added numerically to cp in J/(kgK) without conversion.
unit_derivations.qualification: v labels vapor, not by itself constant-volume heat capacity; this does not prove an error in author code.

unit_derivations.derivation: K_s^-1=K_min^-1/60; Dh_m=Dh_mm/1000. Re=rho*w*Dh/mu and Pr=ca*mu/ka are dimensionless only with consistent SI units; h=ka*Nu/Dh has W/(m^2K).
unit_derivations.qualification: Conversion is not proof of applicability of the chosen convection correlation.

unit_derivations.derivation: x=.622*pv/(P-pv) implies pv=P*x/(x+.622); RH=pv/Pvs is a fraction, percent=100*RH.
unit_derivations.qualification: Requires consistent humidity-ratio definition and pressure; not a same-run measured RH record.

unit_derivations.derivation: With ET in J, SMR=mwev/(ET/3600000) kg/kWh and SEC=(ET/1000)/mwev kJ/kg; QT uses seconds and MR hours.
unit_derivations.qualification: mwev and interval denominators must be nonzero where ratios are used; zero removal makes SEC undefined. Eq13-19 are calculated indicators, not independent calorimetry or total oven energy.
